text: Demand has pushed China’s lithium hexafluorophosphate (LiPF6) market out of prior production losses in 2026, with spot prices briefly exceeding 160,000 yuan/ton. Prices in 1H showed a spike-then-retreat pattern, but industry margins have risen materially. Several listed producers
text_zh: 需求推动中国六氟磷酸锂市场在2026年摆脱此前产量亏损状态，现货价格一度突破16万元/吨。上半年价格呈现冲高回落走势，但行业利润率已显著回升。多家上市生产商
